items.title: Buzzy Williams Interview, 1980-06-18
items.q: Well Vett is still living, huh?

ctx.x: Well he was a famous newspaper man, either a sports writer or something, but he was originator of, I mean he got the Boswell's sister started I think, I don't know. Connie and the, what was it, two sisters? Connie was the crippled one. The crippled one, yeah.
Well Vett is still living, huh? No, they're all gone, no they're gone. One of them, one of them is alive. Yeah, there's a guy, there's a guy in Metry that keeps rights to all the time.
They broke up, you know, Connie went by herself for one.
